prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: transparent full-body game sprite animation atlas, 4 columns by 4 rows, exactly 16 consecutive complete poses. Output high-resolution square PNG with true alpha, no grid lines, no text.
Input image 1 is THE APPROVED CHARACTER AND PROPORTION REFERENCE. Its squat body is mandatory. Input image 2 is only a motion reference for a blunt mushroom cap/body headbutt, not a shape or color reference.
Create a counterattack animation of precisely the character in image 1: broad stacked red-orange mushroom carapace with three scalloped shelf layers, narrow cream trim, deep wine under-cap, tiny ivory rounded SHORT body and two tiny ivory feet, two dark teal eyes. The approved character's silhouette is WIDE AND LOW, total crown-to-floor height approximately 70% of its full cap width. The exposed ivory body below the cap is only about 27% of the cap width. Do not lengthen its white body or neck; its short body barely projects under the cap. Do not alter cap layer count, palette, cream edging, eye design or rendering style.
Every pose must be a fresh complete-body rendering. Exactly one complete character per cell, consistent scale and camera, adequate transparent margins. All poses share the same floor and mostly the same center. In neutral frames the width is about 70% of each cell and height about 49% of each cell. No separate shadows or effects. Do not make the character taller to fill cells. The first and last pose must match image 1's neutral short/squat proportions almost exactly.
Animation sequence, row-major:
0 exact squat neutral.
1 small rightward focus, tiny cap turn, short body unchanged.
2 weight shifts back, cap slightly tilts up to the left without raising or lengthening body.
3 compact anticipation, weight on back foot, cap tilted 15 degrees.
4 crouch compact and prepare.
5 distinct contact: quick full-body blunt headbutt to the RIGHT, rightmost cap edge pushed forward/down; body leans right while staying short, a slight forward offset.
6 maximum rightward contact with cap tilted down, eyes determined.
7 short follow-through with compact body.
8 settle pressure forward.
9 begin recoil, cap rising slightly.
10 recoil halfway.
11 return pelvis and feet to neutral center.
12 cap approaching level, relaxed eyes.
13 nearly neutral squat.
14 almost exact neutral.
15 exact neutral squat as frame0.
No blade, antenna, gill fans, secretion sacs, projectile, weapon, particles, speed streaks, scenery, ground plane, labels or collage bits. Absolutely no vertical stretch or long stalk. Preserve short wide silhouette rather than importing the taller body from the motion-reference image. Background must be truly transparent.
